title: Lost in Time: A New Temporal Benchmark for VideoLLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating video-language models on video QA benchmarks using only single random frames, shuffled video frames, or reversed videos to demonstrate that questions can be answered without temporal reasoning.

Evaluating text-only large language models on video QA benchmarks to show that questions can be correctly answered without any visual input by exploiting overly informative choices, unbalanced answer distributions, and prior world knowledge.
